parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan. You can specify multiple backup plan IDs, separated by commas.

parameters.name: BackupPlanName
parameters.description: The name of the backup plan.

parameters.name: BackupPlanStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the backup plan. Valid values:

- **wait**: The backup plan is not configured.

- **init**: The backup plan is not started because a precheck failed.

- **running**: The backup plan is running.

- **stop**: The backup plan has failed.

- **pause**: The backup plan is paused.

- **locked**: The backup plan is locked.

- **check\_pass**: The precheck is passed.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

> The default value is **30**.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the backup plan is located. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~2869853~~) operation to query the list of supported regions.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ShowBackupStrategyInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return information about the backup strategy. Default value: false.

parameters.name: ShowRecoverTimeRange
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the recovery time range. Default value: false.

parameters.name: ShowStorageStrategyInfo
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return information about the storage strategy. Default value: false.
